label: About
title: About A Shout Comes Apart
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 1415 recent saved-signal files and 872 captured links, then narrowed the page to 8 source windows around @gizakdag: Mood and @sergeantsref: --sref 112233664, plus 6 more. A source image from pbs.twimg.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became A Shout Comes Apart: Vertical coral poster: a huge blue muzzle opens coral lips around teeth, red tongue and black depth; coarse white cheek joins a narrow white neck and blue-white knit. Apart, hooked black horns, drooping ears, blue brow, ragged coral tuft and a red eye form the second large mass. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 8 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against Coral lip surrounding white teeth and a red tongue, Hooked black horns and drooping ears around a blue brow, and Folded red seam bordered by pale pink scallops.

typography.rationale: Fraunces and Newsreader fit image-led art objects while Space Grotesk keeps process labels crisp.
